chunk.content: The Taiwanese strain of red hybrid tilapia was produced by crossing mutant reddish-orange female Oreochromis mossambicus with normal male O. niloticus.
chunk.source_quote: Mutant reddish-orange female Oreochromis mossambicus (Peters, 1852) and normal male O. niloticus crosses have been used to produce the Taiwanese strain

source.title: Red Hybrid Tilapia (Oreochromis spp.) Broodstock Development Programme in Malaysia: Status, Challenges and Prospects for Future Development (doi:10.33997/j.afs.2021.34.1.008)
